## Professional career
### New England Patriots
#### 2007: Perfect regular season and first MVP
Brady finished the season with 4,806 passing yards, 50 touchdown passes, eight interceptions, and a career-high 117.2 passer rating.

#### 2012 and 2013 seasons
He finished the season with 4,827 passing yards, 34 touchdowns, only eight interceptions, and a passer rating of 98.7.

In the first two games of the season, Brady completed 52% of his passes and had three touchdowns and one interception.

### Tampa Bay Buccaneers
#### 2020 season: Seventh Super Bowl win
[[426]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tom_Brady#cite_note-nfl20211025-429) In Week 16 against the Lions, Brady completed 22-of-27 attempts with 348 yards, four touchdowns, and a [perfect passer rating of 158.3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_NFL_quarterbacks_who_have_posted_a_perfect_passer_rating) in the first half before being rested in the second half of the 47–7 victory.

#### 2021 season
Brady finished the 2021 season with an NFL record 485 pass completions for a career-high 5,316 passing yards, 43 passing touchdowns, and 12 interceptions.

Brady completed 29 of 37 passes for 271 yards and 2 touchdowns as they won 31–15.
